entries.title: When Does Structured Knowledge Help Neural Theorem Proving?
entries.observed_artifact: GitHub README says project page; displayed tree is Astro website. Runnable evaluation code not established by this read.
entries.reported_result: Augmentation effects vary by model and problem; complementary solved sets can exceed any single mode.
entries.relevance_inference: Context/method complementarity motivates testing existing lane selection against an equal-budget baseline rather than adding retrieval everywhere.
entries.bounded_next_check: Use existing per-row coverage and saved route availability to identify untried eligible lanes with different prerequisites; no new model calls. New search only after the exact job key and inputs pass negative memory.

entries.title: Learning to Discover Interesting Mathematics
entries.reported_result: Authors propose proof/statement length and conditional proof difficulty to rank useful novel theorems.
entries.relevance_inference: For ACC donor selection, downstream reachability benefit is a better candidate screen than collecting long routes by count alone. Directly copying the theorem-length metric would be unjustified.
entries.bounded_next_check: For one newly authenticated donor, compare selected-start distances and named-state connectivity before/after edge addition within existing record cap. Retain zero-benefit result; don't reopen all old probes.
